title: License
description: Your McHarbor license, what it covers, and how much of it is in use.

banner.overage: {{used}} of {{limit}} licensed servers in use. Please contact us.
banner.overageHint: Nothing has been limited — every environment keeps running.
banner.expired: Your {{tier}} license expired on {{date}}. Nothing has been disabled — please renew.
banner.expiredHint: Every environment keeps running while you renew.
banner.unlicensed: {{used}} servers in use without a license. Please contact us.
banner.unlicensedHint: Nothing has been limited — request a license when it suits you.
banner.offline: McHarbor has not reached the license server for {{count}} days. Licensing is unaffected.
banner.suspended: This license is suspended. Nothing has been disabled.
banner.suspendedHint: Every environment keeps running while this is sorted out.
banner.revoked: This license has been revoked. Nothing has been disabled.
banner.revokedHint: A new license key is needed — every environment keeps running.
banner.pending_approval: This license is waiting for approval by McHarbor.
banner.pending_approvalHint: The key is valid; its term starts once approval comes through.
banner.not_started: This license has not started yet.
banner.not_startedHint: Nothing has been limited — it becomes active on its start date.

status.title: Status
status.serverNotConfigured: No license server is configured, so this install keeps the license it has and reports nothing outward.
status.seatLost: Not held — activate again to claim one
status.offline: The license server has not been reached for {{count}} days. The cached entitlement is being used and nothing has been limited.

actions.releaseConfirmBody: The seat is returned to your license so it can be used elsewhere. McHarbor keeps running exactly as it does now.

usage.title: Recorded usage
usage.description: What this install has been using, kept locally for the renewal conversation. Nothing is uploaded.

noPermission: You do not have permission to view license details.

lastErrorReason.unknown_key: The license server does not recognise this key
lastErrorReason.instance_not_found: This instance is not registered on the license
lastErrorReason.seat_limit_reached: Every seat on this license is in use
lastErrorReason.not_started: The license term has not started
lastErrorReason.refused: The license server refused the last request
lastErrorReason.rate_limited: The license server asked us to slow down
lastErrorReason.unavailable: The license server could not be reached
lastErrorReason.unknown: The last check did not complete

reason.expired: The term ran out. Renewing or extending revives the same key.
reason.suspended: An administrator paused this license. Reinstatement needs no new key.
reason.revoked: This license was withdrawn. A new key is required.
reason.pending_approval: Waiting for approval by McHarbor. Approval starts the term on the same key.
reason.not_started: The term begins on the start date shown above.
reason.seat_limit_reached: Every seat on this license is in use.

instance.title: Instance
instance.description: This installation's seat on the license server. Quote it when you contact us, and use it to release the seat from your license dashboard.

activate.title: Activate a license
activate.description: Paste the license key McHarbor issued. This install claims one seat against it.
activate.keyHint: Exactly as issued, including the dashes.
activate.seatNote: Each McHarbor server and each agent takes one seat. Activating again with the same key refreshes this seat rather than taking a second one.
